about:
SurePoint Electronics operates from Atwood, Kansas, a high-plains town in Rawlins County. The company was founded as a subsidiary of SurePoint Ag, a manufacturer of precision agriculture systems, with the goal of supplying high-quality electronics to the precision agriculture market. Ownership remains with the parent company, and no individual founders are named in public materials.

The shop produces OEM-quality wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and complete electronics assemblies including box builds, circuit boards, and controllers. Manufacturing combines automated equipment with hand assembly, and every harness undergoes Cirrus computer-interfaced testing for pin-out, continuity, resistance, and functionality. The team also provides harness braiding for agricultural, automotive, and heavy-equipment applications, and offers full-service development from concept through prototype to production with on-staff engineering support.

While its primary customer is its parent company, SurePoint Ag Systems, the business serves external OEMs in precision agriculture, general agriculture, automotive, and heavy equipment. It targets companies that need reliable wire harnessing, cable assemblies, and electronics manufacturing.

The company emphasizes responsive communication, on-time delivery, and a willingness to expedite urgent projects. Its stated differentiators include in-house engineering, Cirrus-certified testing, and a partnership approach that ties its success to the customer's.
